positive_sequences.name: write_then_execute_user_temp
positive_sequences.scenario: Executable written to the per-user temporary directory and then executed.
positive_sequences.rationale: Both stages share the host and the artefact path alias inside the window.

positive_sequences.name: write_then_execute_public
positive_sequences.scenario: Executable written to the public directory and then executed.
positive_sequences.rationale: Both stages share the host and the artefact path alias inside the window.

negative_sequences.name: execute_then_write
negative_sequences.scenario: A binary executes before an executable of the same name is written.
negative_sequences.rationale: The ordered requirement is not satisfied.

negative_sequences.name: write_then_execute_different_file
negative_sequences.scenario: An executable is written and a different temporary binary executes.
negative_sequences.rationale: The artefact path alias differs between the two stages.

negative_sequences.name: execution_outside_window
negative_sequences.scenario: An executable is written and executed thirty minutes later.
negative_sequences.rationale: The sequence exceeds the five minute timespan.

notes: All sequences are synthetic and deterministic. Negative sequences break exactly one correlation requirement each: ordering, grouping, threshold, or timespan.
